items.statement: The investigation verifies the unique neutral C15H19N5S molecule from CCDC 2449676 and preserves an explicit atom mapping to the experimental component.
items.expected: Record 2449676, formula and neutral charge are verified; mapping basis is reported.

items.statement: The autonomous calculation reports conformer-generation coverage, deduplication, optimization and stationary-point validation without claiming unsupported global completeness.
items.expected: The method and coverage are reproducible and each advanced candidate is validated or documented as failed.

items.statement: The investigation reports HOMO, LUMO and the frontier-orbital gap for a validated selected minimum.
items.expected: Numeric orbital energies and gap are reported in eV with sign convention.

items.statement: The selected optimized structure is compared to the CCDC crystal geometry using explicit atom mapping and bond, angle and torsion observables.
items.expected: The comparison is reproducible and supports a bounded agreement or disagreement statement.
